title: epilobium montanum subsp. lanceolatum
intro: Epilobium montanum subsp. lanceolatum, commonly known as Alpine Willowherb, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Onagraceae. It is used in traditional medicine to support urinary health, particularly in treating conditions such as kidney stones and urinary tract infections, due to its ability to reduce inflammation and kill bacteria. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Willowherb include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiproliferative effects. The plant's therapeutic actions can be attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and protect against cell damage, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
